alex (support): FYI customer AcmeCorp opened a ticket asking for streaming function call events + structured JSON frames for partial outputs. They need partial toolcall events so their UI can render incrementally.

maya (pm): Can you paste the ticket summary? priority?

alex (support): Ticket: wants chat streaming where tool calls are emitted as separate events, e.g. 'tool_call_start', 'tool_call_chunk', 'tool_call_end' with structured payloads. They reported current workaround (batch after finish) causes 10s UX lag. Customer is on Dedicated, urgent for Q3 pilot.

jon (product): Important ask. Does this overlap with existing streaming fncall work? We have streaming partials for completions but toolcall structured events are incomplete.

sam (engineer): Correct — runtime currently streams token deltas. We emit final function call JSON as one message at end. Supporting intermediate frames means changing message framing and client protocol. Effort: medium but non-trivial because of KV cache/merge semantics.

maya (pm): Proposed scope: (1) wire protocol for structured event frames, (2) server-side emit of toolcall life-cycle events, (3) SDK helpers to surface events, (4) backward compat toggle and migration docs. Thoughts?

tess (sales): From Acme - they need SDK event hooks (web + mobile) and a guarantee fallback to single final call if their client doesn't support frames. Without fallback they break. Also wants security assurance (no extra PII leaks).

alex (support): Also two other customers asked similar in last month. I can share three ticket IDs.

sam (engineer): Implementation notes: we can reuse existing stream envelope but add `event_type` and `event_payload` fields. Example envelope:
```json
{ "event_type": "tool_call_chunk", "request_id": "abc123", "payload": { "name": "search", "partial_args": {"query_chunk": "foo"} } }
```
This keeps compatibility with existing streaming parser as long as SDKs ignore unknown event_type.

jon (product): Acceptance criteria for launch: customer integration works end-to-end, SDKs emit event callbacks, docs and migration guide, perf regression < 5% p50 latency, explicit fallback mode tested. Also include security review and test harness.

maya (pm): Prioritization: classify as P1 for Dedicated customers with active pilots (Acme + 2 others). For Hosted we can schedule later unless sales surfaces more ARR. Estimate: 4 sprint dev + 1 sprint QA/docs.

sam (engineer): Rough breakdown: 2 sprint backend, 1 sprint SDKs, 1 sprint infra/compat, 1 sprint end-to-end + fixes. Risk: client fragmentation and parsing complexity. Need product decision on stable envelope shape.

jon (product): Decision: go with phased rollout. Phase 1 beta for Dedicated (opt-in flag per workspace), Phase 2 default-on for new SDKs, Phase 3 deprecate legacy single-call behavior after 6 months.

maya (pm): Next steps: alex to collect tickets and customer acceptance tests; sam to draft PRD with envelope spec and perf targets; jon to add to roadmap and create a priority matrix linking ARR/urgency/engineering.

alex (support): Got it — I'll send ticket list and ask Acme for a short test plan (steps they will run).

sam (engineer): I'll prototype envelope shape today and post a short example in #eng-runtime.

maya (pm): Owners: maya (PM) — overall, sam (ENG) — tech lead, alex (Support) — customer validation, jon (Product) — launch decision, tess (Sales) — commercial notes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to staging for branch feat/toolcall-streaming in ~2h :rocket:

maya (pm): Thanks all — I'll create the product ticket and link this thread.

jon (product): Add entry criteria: product sign-off, security checklist done, experimental flag implemented.

alex (support): I'll coordinate a pilot kickoff once we have a staging endpoint. :+1:

maya (pm): Closing loop — I'll update roadmap doc and assign JIRA tickets today.
